name: 37664 · Kingsport, TN
findings: ZIP 37664 (Kingsport) has 71 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37664 (Kingsport) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 37664 (Kingsport) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
